note: Battery testing standards database. Each standard is an entity with scope, battery type, chemistry and what it covers. Fields are cross-verified; detailed pass/fail parameters belong in the standard text itself.

standards.scope: Cranking-ampere rating of 12V starter batteries — CCA at −18°C (0°F) for 30 s to ≥7.2V; CA at 0°C; HCA at 27°C.
European lead-acid starter-battery standard — capacity (C20), CCA at −18°C, charge acceptance, and cycle endurance for SLI, EFB and AGM.
Japanese automotive lead-acid standard — CCA measured at −15°C (warmer than EN/SAE), so its CCA number reads higher for the same battery.
German starter-battery test — CCA at −18°C with a stricter 9.0V cut-off, so its CCA number reads lower than EN/SAE for the same battery.
International lead-acid starter-battery standard — dimensional and electrical requirements for automotive SLI batteries.
Lithium-ion cell standard for EV propulsion — performance, cycle life and abuse tests at cell level.
Safety requirements for portable sealed secondary lithium cells and batteries — overcharge, short circuit, thermal abuse.
UN Manual of Tests and Criteria Part III — eight tests (altitude, thermal, vibration, shock, short circuit, impact, overcharge, forced discharge) required for lithium battery transport.
Safety standard for stationary energy-storage batteries — cell, module and system abuse and thermal-runaway requirements.

standards.object: Safety of batteries for use in electric vehicles
standards.scope: Covers the safety of EV battery packs and modules against electrical, mechanical and environmental abuse, including crush, drop, short circuit and thermal exposure requirements.

standards.object: Maintenance, testing and replacement of VRLA batteries for stationary applications
standards.scope: Defines inspection intervals, capacity testing practice and replacement criteria for valve-regulated lead-acid batteries in stationary standby service.

standards.object: Safety requirements for secondary battery rooms and installations
standards.scope: Sets ventilation, separation and safety requirements for rooms and installations containing secondary batteries, governing hydrogen management for lead-acid and fire safety provisions.

standards.object: Air transport of lithium batteries as dangerous goods
standards.scope: The air-transport regulation for lithium cells and batteries: classification as dangerous goods, packaging instructions, state-of-charge limits and documentation requirements.
The dangerous-goods entry for vehicles and equipment powered by batteries, covering the classification and transport requirements for whole vehicles and self-propelled equipment.
Defines abuse test procedures and pass criteria for EV battery systems, including short circuit, overcharge, crush, nail penetration, immersion and thermal exposure.
